name: hcapp_getRunAllPhotos
description: Returns every photo for a specific event regardless of status — pending, approved at any level, private, and soft-deleted (DeletedAt set) — newest first, to power the photo review screen (Pending and Reviewed tabs) and its status-count header. Gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'batchPhotos' on @kennelId (feature 'Batch / view all photos'; SuperAdmin always) — errorCode 1334, errorType 13 otherwise. Unlike hcapp_getKennelPendingPhotos (one status, every event) this shows every status for one event. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 36, @param NULL). Parameter and permission checks run before the TRY; the SELECT is wrapped, with runtime errors logged and re-thrown.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel the event belongs to. Used for role check and to scope the query. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 12).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to fetch all photos for. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1234, errorType 12).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth), missing ids (1234/12) or no permission (1334/13): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Mutually exclusive with AllPhotos.
Returned only on auth, validation, or role check failure (paired with ErrorEnvelope at index 0). Not present on success.

rowsets.name: AllPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: all photos for the event regardless of status (including soft-deleted where DeletedAt IS NOT NULL), joined to Hasher and Event for display context, ordered by CreatedAt DESC. Returns zero rows if the event has no photos. Mutually exclusive with ErrorEnvelope.

columns.name: photoId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.id — primary key of the photo.

columns.name: Featured
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Featured — 1 when a reviewer starred the photo.

columns.name: DeletedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.DeletedAt — NULL if not soft-deleted; non-NULL timestamp if soft-deleted.

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the Hash Flash-edited version, if any.

columns.name: CreatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.CreatedAt — UTC timestamp when the photo was recorded.

columns.name: TakenAtUtc
columns.description: When the photo was taken (UTC). NULL for rows written before capture time was recorded — callers fall back to the PHO:: track point.

columns.name: uploaderDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) — the display name of the uploader.

columns.name: eventNumber
columns.description: Event.AbsoluteEventNumber — cross-kennel run number. Nullable in the base table.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing ids (line 69), no permission (line 89) and from the CATCH block (lines 127-129, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: All four parameters (lines 3-6) have no SQL default. A client that omits @kennelId or @eventId gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs, so the graceful 1234 check at line 65 is unreachable for an omitted parameter.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.
This SP gates on 'batchPhotos' (line 84); the kennel-wide pending list gates on 'reviewPhotos'. Both are rows of HC.PermissionFunction, so whether the same roles hold both is data, not code.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
